frame.origin: the centre of the cube on the ground plane (MP-y-c_caseI.png, MP-z-c_caseI.png)
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x): the cube occupies x in [-0.05, 0.05]; wind points x = -0.15 .. 0.25, concentration points x = 0.065 .. 2.7
frame.y: +y lateral; the cube spans y in [-0.05, 0.05]; wind points on y = 0 and on the plane z = 0.05 at |y| <= 0.15, concentration points on y = 0 and on the ground at |y| <= 0.44
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.1 m; the source (6 mm outlet) at (0, 0, 0.1)
frame.source: ethane, 10 % in the mixture, 400 cc/min through a 6 mm circular outlet at the roof centre (M = 0.14)
frame.length_scale: model metres (the source states no model:full scale ratio; Eddy3D solves it at 1:60)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated 0.1 m cube centred on the origin (MP-y-c_caseI.png, MP-z-c_caseI.png); x, y in [-0.05, 0.05], z in [0, 0.1]. The 6 mm roof outlet at (0, 0, 0.1) is not part of the body
